status = #{toStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.task_id AS taskId, a.step_id AS stepId, a.approval_type AS approvalType, a.status, a.requested_by AS requestedBy, a.reviewer_id AS reviewerId, a.reason, a.target_summary AS targetSummary, a.parameter_hash AS parameterHash, a.expires_at AS expiresAt, a.decided_at AS decidedAt, a.decision_comment AS decisionComment, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_approval a WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId} AND a.approval_type = #{approvalType} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id, a.task_id AS taskId, a.step_id AS stepId, a.approval_type AS approvalType, a.status, a.requested_by AS requestedBy, a.reviewer_id AS reviewerId, a.reason, a.target_summary AS targetSummary, a.parameter_hash AS parameterHash, a.expires_at AS expiresAt, a.decided_at AS decidedAt, a.decision_comment AS decisionComment, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_approval a WHERE a.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE app_agent_approval SET status = #{toStatus}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, decision_comment = #{decisionComment}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE app_agent_task SET total_steps = 0, completed_steps = 0, current_step_id = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS stepId, s.task_id AS taskId, s.step_key AS stepKey, s.step_name AS stepName, s.agent_role AS agentRole, s.step_type AS stepType, s.tool_name AS toolName, s.attempt_count AS attemptCount, s.max_attempts AS maxAttempts, t.status AS taskStatus, t.title AS taskTitle, t.objective AS taskObjective, t.constraints_json AS constraintsJson, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.risk_level AS riskLevel, t.token_usage AS tokenUsage, t.cost_amount AS costAmount, s.input_json AS inputJson FROM app_agent_step s INNER JOIN app_agent_task t ON t.id = s.task_id WHERE s.status = 'READY' AND t.status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING') AND (s.lease_until IS NULL OR s.lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY t.priority DESC, s.updated_at ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_agent_step SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{stepId} AND status = 'READY' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_agent_task t WHERE t.id = app_agent_step.task_id AND t.status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING') )

UPDATE app_agent_step SET status = 'READY', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = 'WORKER_LEASE_EXPIRED', error_message = 'Worker lease expired; step returned to ready state', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now} AND attempt_count < max_attempts

UPDATE app_agent_step SET status = 'FAILED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = 'WORKER_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED', error_message = 'Worker lease expired after maximum attempts', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now} AND attempt_count >= max_attempts

UPDATE app_agent_task SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = 'Agent step attempts exhausted', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_agent_step s WHERE s.task_id = app_agent_task.id AND s.status = 'FAILED' )

UPDATE app_agent_step SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', output_json = #{outputJson}, output_summary = #{outputSummary}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{stepId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner}

UPDATE app_agent_step SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{stepId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS stepId, s.task_id AS taskId, s.step_key AS stepKey FROM app_agent_step s WHERE s.task_id = #{taskId} AND s.status = 'BLOCKED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_agent_step previous WHERE previous.task_id = s.task_id AND previous.sort_order < s.sort_order AND previous.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'SKIPPED') ) ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE app_agent_step SET status = 'READY', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{stepId} AND status = 'BLOCKED'

UPDATE app_agent_task SET completed_steps = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_step s WHERE s.task_id = app_agent_task.id AND s.status = 'SUCCEEDED' ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId}

UPDATE app_agent_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_agent_step s WHERE s.task_id = app_agent_task.id AND s.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'SKIPPED') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_agent_step degraded WHERE degraded.task_id = app_agent_task.id AND JSON_VALID(degraded.output_json) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(degraded.output_json, '$.degraded')) = 'true' )

UPDATE app_agent_task SET status = 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS', last_error = 'Agent 任务完成，但部分可选产物降级或跳过', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_agent_step s WHERE s.task_id = app_agent_task.id AND s.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'SKIPPED') ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_agent_step degraded WHERE degraded.task_id = app_agent_task.id AND JSON_VALID(degraded.output_json) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(degraded.output_json, '$.degraded')) = 'true' )

UPDATE app_agent_task SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION')

UPDATE app_agent_task t SET token_usage = COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a.prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(a.completion_tokens, 0)) FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.request_id REGEXP CONCAT('^agent[^0-9]*', t.id, '([^0-9]|$)') ), 0), cost_amount = COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a.total_cost_usd, 0)) FROM app_generation_attempt a WHERE a.request_id REGEXP CONCAT('^agent[^0-9]*', t.id, '([^0-9]|$)') ), 0), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE t.id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN (max_tokens > 0 AND token_usage >= max_tokens) OR (max_cost > 0 AND cost_amount >= max_cost) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM app_agent_task WHERE id = #{taskId}

SELECT CASE WHEN started_at IS NOT NULL AND max_runtime_seconds > 0 AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) >= max_runtime_seconds THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM app_agent_task WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_agent_step SET status = 'CANCELLED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, finished_at = COALESCE(finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'BLOCKED', 'READY', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'RETRY_WAITING')

UPDATE app_agent_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', last_error = COALESCE(last_error, 'Agent 任务已取消'), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_agent_step s WHERE s.task_id = app_agent_task.id AND s.status = 'RUNNING' )

UPDATE app_agent_step SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 'READY' ELSE 'BLOCKED' END, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.tool_key AS toolKey, d.version, d.risk_level AS riskLevel, d.approval_required AS approvalRequired, d.enabled, d.timeout_seconds AS timeoutSeconds, d.max_retries AS maxRetries FROM app_agent_tool_definition d WHERE d.tool_key = #{toolKey} ORDER BY d.enabled DESC, d.version DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE app_agent_tool_call SET status = #{status}, output_summary = #{outputSummary}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, token_usage = #{tokenUsage}, cost_amount = COALESCE(#{costAmount}, 0), provider = #{provider}, model_name = #{modelName}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_agent_artifact ( task_id, step_id, artifact_key, artifact_type, name, version, status, uri, content_hash, size_bytes, mime_type, metadata_json, content_json ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{stepId}, #{artifactKey}, #{artifactType}, #{name}, #{version}, #{status}, #{uri}, #{contentHash}, #{sizeBytes}, #{mimeType}, #{metadataJson}, #{contentJson} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE step_id = VALUES(step_id), name = VALUES(name), status = VALUES(status), uri = VALUES(uri), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), size_bytes = VALUES(size_bytes), mime_type = VALUES(mime_type), metadata_json = VALUES(metadata_json), content_json = VALUES(content_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE app_agent_task SET artifact_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_artifact a WHERE a.task_id = app_agent_task.id AND a.status = 'READY' ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.task_id AS taskId, a.step_id AS stepId, a.artifact_key AS artifactKey, a.artifact_type AS artifactType, a.name, a.version, a.status, a.uri, a.content_hash AS contentHash, a.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, a.mime_type AS mimeType, a.metadata_json AS metadataJson, a.content_json AS contentJson, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_artifact a WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId} AND a.artifact_key = #{artifactKey} AND a.version = #{version} LIMIT 1

where.if: AND ( t.task_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.objective LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_task) AS totalTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_task WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE) AS todayTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING') AS runningTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_task WHERE status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL') AS waitingApprovalTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_task WHERE status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS')) AS succeededTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_task WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failedTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_approval WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pendingApprovals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_tool_definition WHERE enabled = 1) AS enabledTools, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_tool_call WHERE status = 'RUNNING') AS runningToolCalls, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_artifact WHERE status = 'READY') AS readyArtifacts, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(token_usage) FROM app_agent_task), 0) AS totalTokenUsage, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cost_amount) FROM app_agent_task), 0) AS totalCostAmount
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_task t

SELECT t.id, t.task_key AS taskKey, t.task_type AS taskType, t.title, t.status, t.risk_level AS riskLevel, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.priority, t.max_steps AS maxSteps, t.max_retries AS maxRetries, t.max_runtime_seconds AS maxRuntimeSeconds, t.max_tokens AS maxTokens, t.max_cost AS maxCost, t.current_step_id AS currentStepId, t.total_steps AS totalSteps, t.completed_steps AS completedSteps, t.retry_count AS retryCount, t.token_usage AS tokenUsage, t.cost_amount AS costAmount, t.artifact_count AS artifactCount, t.started_at AS startedAt, t.finished_at AS finishedAt, COALESCE(t.last_error, '') AS lastError, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_task t
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'RUNNING' THEN 0 WHEN t.status IN ('WAITING_APPROVAL', 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION') THEN 1 WHEN t.status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.id, t.task_key AS taskKey, t.task_type AS taskType, t.title, t.objective, t.constraints_json AS constraintsJson, t.status, t.risk_level AS riskLevel, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.priority, t.max_steps AS maxSteps, t.max_retries AS maxRetries, t.max_runtime_seconds AS maxRuntimeSeconds, t.max_tokens AS maxTokens, t.max_cost AS maxCost, t.current_step_id AS currentStepId, t.total_steps AS totalSteps, t.completed_steps AS completedSteps, t.retry_count AS retryCount, t.token_usage AS tokenUsage, t.cost_amount AS costAmount, t.artifact_count AS artifactCount, t.started_at AS startedAt, t.finished_at AS finishedAt, COALESCE(t.last_error, '') AS lastError, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_task t WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.task_id AS taskId, s.plan_id AS planId, s.step_key AS stepKey, s.step_name AS stepName, s.agent_role AS agentRole, s.step_type AS stepType, s.status, s.depends_on_json AS dependsOnJson, s.tool_name AS toolName, s.input_json AS inputJson, s.output_json AS outputJson, s.output_summary AS outputSummary, s.attempt_count AS attemptCount, s.max_attempts AS maxAttempts, s.risk_level AS riskLevel, s.lease_owner AS leaseOwner, s.lease_until AS leaseUntil, s.sort_order AS sortOrder, s.started_at AS startedAt, s.finished_at AS finishedAt, COALESCE(s.error_code, '') AS errorCode, COALESCE(s.error_message, '') AS errorMessage, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_step s WHERE s.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.task_id AS taskId, c.step_id AS stepId, s.step_name AS stepName, s.tool_name AS toolName, c.tool_definition_id AS toolDefinitionId, c.attempt, c.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, c.status, c.input_hash AS inputHash, c.input_summary AS inputSummary, c.output_summary AS outputSummary, c.output_ref AS outputRef, c.error_code AS errorCode, c.error_message AS errorMessage, c.duration_ms AS durationMs, c.provider, c.model_name AS modelName, c.token_usage AS tokenUsage, c.cost_amount AS costAmount, c.started_at AS startedAt, c.finished_at AS finishedAt, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM app_agent_tool_call c LEFT JOIN app_agent_step s ON s.id = c.step_id WHERE c.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
